check_remote() {
  ssh -o ConnectTimeout=10 -p 29999 root@connect.westd.seetacloud.com "$1" 2>/dev/null
}

phi4_done=0
gemma_done=0
olmo_done=0

while true; do
  alive=$(check_remote "ps -p 121916,141707,143735 -o pid= 2>/dev/null" || true)
  
  if [ "$phi4_done" -eq 0 ] && ! echo "$alive" | grep -q 121916; then
    echo "DONE: Phi-4 d100 training (PID 121916)"
    phi4_done=1
  fi
  if [ "$gemma_done" -eq 0 ] && ! echo "$alive" | grep -q 141707; then
    echo "DONE: Gemma d100 eval (PID 141707)"
    gemma_done=1
  fi
  if [ "$olmo_done" -eq 0 ] && ! echo "$alive" | grep -q 143735; then
    echo "DONE: OLMo d025 eval (PID 143735)"
    olmo_done=1
  fi
  
  total=$((phi4_done + gemma_done + olmo_done))
  if [ "$total" -ge 3 ]; then
    echo "ALL_REMAINING_DONE"
    exit 0
  fi
  sleep 30
done
